name: @nationaldesignstudio/agent-to-figma-mcp-server

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about the current Figma document including name, pages, and current page details

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get information about the currently selected nodes in Figma

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page in the Figma document

tools.name: set_current_page
tools.description: Set the current page in Figma by page ID

pageId.description: The ID of the page to set as current

tools.name: read_my_design
tools.description: Get detailed information about the current selection in Figma, including all node details

tools.name: get_node_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific node in Figma by its ID

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to get information about

tools.name: get_nodes_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about multiple nodes in Figma by their IDs

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to get information about

tools.name: rename_node
tools.description: Rename a node in Figma. Essential for setting component variant names (e.g., 'Type=Primary, State=Default')

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to rename

name.description: The new name for the node

tools.name: set_node_parent
tools.description: Move a node into a new parent container (reparent). Use this to organize nodes into frames, groups, or sections.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to move

parentId.description: The ID of the new parent container

index.description: Optional index position within the parent's children

tools.name: create_shape
tools.description: Create a shape in Figma. Supports rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, and line types.

width.description: Width of the shape (required for rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star)

height.description: Height of the shape (required for rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star)

length.description: Length of line (required for line type)

rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees (for line, default: 0)

strokeColor.description: Stroke color for line in RGBA format

pointCount.description: Number of sides/points (for polygon: default 3, for star: default 5)

innerRadiusRatio.description: Inner radius ratio for star (0-1, default: 0.382)

parentId.description: Optional parent node ID to append the shape to

tools.name: create_frame
tools.description: Create a new frame in Figma. BEST PRACTICE: Always set layoutMode to 'VERTICAL' or 'HORIZONTAL' for auto-layout. Auto-layout frames automatically position children with consistent spacing (itemSpacing) and padding. Use layoutSizingHorizontal/Vertical for responsive sizing ('HUG' = fit content, 'FILL' = stretch to parent, 'FIXED' = exact size). Avoid creating frames without auto-layout unless you need absolute positioning for overlapping elements.

parentId.description: Optional parent node ID to append the frame to

layoutWrap.description: Whether the auto-layout frame wraps its children

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Primary axis alignment. SPACE_BETWEEN ignores itemSpacing.

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Counter axis alignment for auto-layout frame

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Horizontal sizing mode for auto-layout frame

layoutSizingVertical.description: Vertical sizing mode for auto-layout frame

itemSpacing.description: Distance between children in auto-layout frame

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a new section in Figma. Sections are containers for organizing the canvas.

tools.name: create_slice
tools.description: Create a new slice in Figma. Slices define export regions.

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Create an image node from a URL

url.description: URL of the image to fetch

width.description: Width of the image (default: original size)

height.description: Height of the image (default: original size)

parentId.description: Optional parent node ID to append the shape to

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a new text element in Figma

fontWeight.description: Font weight (e.g., 400 for Regular, 700 for Bold)

name.description: Semantic layer name for the text node

parentId.description: Optional parent node ID to append the text to

tools.name: set_text_content
tools.description: Set the text content of an existing text node in Figma

nodeId.description: The ID of the text node to modify

tools.name: set_text_properties
tools.description: Set advanced text properties on a text node in Figma

nodeId.description: The ID of the text node to modify

tools.name: set_text_range_style
tools.description: Apply formatting to a specific range of characters in a text node

nodeId.description: The ID of the text node to modify

tools.name: set_multiple_text_contents
tools.description: Set text content for multiple text nodes at once (use scan_text_nodes to get node IDs first)

nodeId.description: The root node ID containing the text nodes
The ID of the text node

text.description: Array of node ID and text pairs

tools.name: set_style
tools.description: Set visual styles on a node (fill, stroke, corner radius, opacity, blend mode, rotation, mask). All properties are optional - only provided properties will be changed.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to modify

angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees for linear gradient (default: 0)

corners.description: Which corners to apply radius to [topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft]

strokeAlign.description: Stroke alignment relative to the shape boundary

strokeCap.description: Stroke cap style for line endpoints

dashPattern.description: Dash pattern array (e.g., [10, 5] for dashed line)

isMask.description: Whether to set as mask or remove mask

tools.name: get_local_styles
tools.description: Get local styles from the Figma document. Optionally filter by style type.

type.description: Type of styles to get (omit to get all styles)

tools.name: create_style
tools.description: Create a new style (paint, text, effect, or grid)

fontFamily.description: Font family for text styles (default: Inter)

effectType.description: Type of effect for effect styles (single layer)

radius.description: Blur radius for effect styles (single layer)

offsetX.description: X offset for shadow effects (single layer)

offsetY.description: Y offset for shadow effects (single layer)

effects.description: Array of effect layers for multi-layer effects (takes precedence over single-layer params)

gridType.description: Type of grid for grid styles

tools.name: apply_text_style
tools.description: Apply a text style to one or more text nodes. Use get_local_styles first to find the style ID.

nodeIds.description: Array of text node IDs to apply the style to

styleId.description: The ID of the text style to apply

tools.name: apply_effect_style
tools.description: Apply an effect style to one or more nodes. Use get_local_styles first to find the style ID.

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to apply the effect style to

styleId.description: The ID of the effect style to apply

tools.name: manage_style
tools.description: Manage styles: list, get, create, update, or delete. Use for CRUD operations on paint, text, effect, and grid styles.

type.description: Style type filter (for list) or type to create

styleId.description: Style ID (required for get, update, delete)

tools.name: move_node
tools.description: Move a node to a new position in Figma. WARNING: Prefer auto-layout (create_frame with layoutMode) for positioning elements within containers. Use move_node ONLY for: (1) top-level frames/screens on the canvas, (2) overlapping elements that cannot use auto-layout. For normal layouts, use auto-layout with itemSpacing and padding instead.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to move

tools.name: resize_node
tools.description: Resize a node in Figma

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to resize

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete one or more nodes from Figma

nodeIds.description: Single node ID or array of node IDs to delete

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Clone an existing node in Figma

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to clone

x.description: New X position for the clone

y.description: New Y position for the clone

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group or ungroup nodes. For grouping, provide an array of node IDs. For ungrouping, provide a single node ID with action='ungroup'.

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to group, or single-element array with group ID to ungroup

name.description: Optional name for the group (only for grouping)

tools.name: boolean_operation
tools.description: Perform a boolean operation on nodes (union, subtract, intersect, exclude)

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to combine (minimum 2)

name.description: Optional name for the resulting node

tools.name: flatten_node
tools.description: Flatten a node to a single vector path

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to flatten

tools.name: get_transform
tools.description: Get the absolute and relative transform matrices of a node

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to get transforms for

tools.name: set_relative_transform
tools.description: Set the relative transform matrix of a node (2D affine transformation)

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to transform

transform.description: Transform matrix [[a, b, tx], [c, d, ty]] where a,d=scale, b,c=skew, tx,ty=translate

tools.name: rescale_node
tools.description: Rescale a node by a given factor (affects size, strokes, effects, etc.)

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to rescale

tools.name: set_layout
tools.description: Set auto-layout properties on a frame. All properties are optional - only provided properties will be changed.

nodeId.description: The ID of the frame to modify

layoutWrap.description: Whether the frame should wrap its children

itemSpacing.description: Spacing between items on primary axis

counterAxisSpacing.description: Spacing between items on counter axis (for wrapped frames)

tools.name: set_constraints
tools.description: Set the horizontal and vertical constraints of a node in Figma

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to modify

tools.name: set_grid_layout
tools.description: Set a frame to CSS Grid layout mode with configurable columns, rows, and gaps

nodeId.description: The ID of the frame to modify

gridColumnCount.description: Number of columns in the grid

gridRowCount.description: Number of rows in the grid

tools.name: set_grid_child_position
tools.description: Position a child node at a specific row and column in a grid layout

childId.description: The ID of the child node to position

tools.name: manage_component
tools.description: Manage components: list local components, create component (from node or empty), create component set, combine as variants, or detach instance

nodeId.description: Node ID (for create from existing node, or detach)

tools.name: create_instance
tools.description: Create a component instance: by_key (from library using component key) or by_id (from local component using node ID)

type.description: Instance creation method: by_key (library) or by_id (local)

parentId.description: Parent node ID to append instance to

tools.name: manage_instance
tools.description: Manage component instances: get_overrides (inspect overrides), set_overrides (copy overrides from source to targets), set_variant (change variant property)

nodeId.description: Instance node ID (uses selection if not provided for get_overrides)

tools.name: import_from_library
tools.description: Import a component or style from a team library by its key

key.description: The key of the component or style to import

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Get all styles from the current Figma document

tools.name: manage_annotation
tools.description: Manage annotations: get annotations from a node, set/update a single annotation, or set multiple annotations at once

nodeId.description: Node ID (required for get/set, root node for set_multiple)

annotationId.description: Annotation ID to update (for set action)

labelMarkdown.description: Annotation text in markdown (required for set action)

annotations.description: Array of annotations (required for set_multiple action)

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to annotate

tools.name: export_node_as_image
tools.description: Export a node as an image from Figma

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to export

tools.name: set_effect
tools.description: Add or update an effect on a node (drop shadow, inner shadow, layer blur, or background blur)

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to modify

color.description: Effect color for shadows (default: black with 25% opacity)

tools.name: remove_effects
tools.description: Remove all effects from a node

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to modify

tools.name: set_focus
tools.description: Focus on a specific node in Figma (scroll and zoom to it)

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to focus on

tools.name: set_selections
tools.description: Select specific nodes in Figma

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to select

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get all prototyping reactions (interactions) from specified nodes

nodeIds.description: Array of node IDs to get reactions from

tools.name: set_default_connector
tools.description: Set the default connector for prototyping connections

connectorId.description: The ID of the connector to use as default

tools.name: create_connections
tools.description: Create prototyping connections between nodes

startNodeId.description: The ID of the start node

endNodeId.description: The ID of the end/destination node

text.description: Optional label text for the connection

tools.name: set_reactions
tools.description: Set prototyping reactions (interactions) on a node using setReactionsAsync

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to set reactions on

tools.name: scan_text_nodes
tools.description: Scan and return all text nodes within a given node tree (useful for bulk text updates)

nodeId.description: The root node ID to scan for text nodes

useChunking.description: Whether to return results in chunks (for large trees)

tools.name: scan_nodes_by_types
tools.description: Scan and return all nodes of specified types within a node tree

nodeId.description: The root node ID to scan

types.description: Array of node types to find (e.g., ['FRAME', 'TEXT', 'RECTANGLE'])

tools.name: manage_variable_collection
tools.description: Manage variable collections: list all, get one, create, update (rename), or delete

action.description: Action to perform on variable collection(s)

collectionId.description: Collection ID (required for get, update, delete)

name.description: Name (required for create, optional for update)

initialModes.description: Initial mode names for create (default creates one mode)

tools.name: manage_variable
tools.description: Manage variables: list in collection, create, update, or delete

name.description: Variable name (required for create, optional for update)

resolveAliases.description: Resolve aliases to final values (for list action)

tools.name: manage_variable_mode
tools.description: Manage variable modes: list, create, rename, or delete modes in a collection

action.description: Action to perform on variable mode(s)

tools.name: set_variable_value
tools.description: Set the value of a variable for a specific mode

value.description: The value (boolean, number, string, RGBA color, or variable alias)

tools.name: manage_variable_binding
tools.description: Bind or unbind a variable to/from a node property or style definition. For styles, provide styleId instead of nodeId. Text style bindable fields: fontFamily, fontSize, fontStyle, fontWeight, letterSpacing, lineHeight, paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent

nodeId.description: The ID of the node (provide either nodeId or styleId)

styleId.description: The ID of the style to bind variable to (for text styles: fontSize, letterSpacing, lineHeight, paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent)

field.description: The field to bind/unbind. For nodes: fills, strokes, cornerRadius, etc. For text styles: fontSize, letterSpacing, lineHeight, paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent

tools.name: manage_extended_collection
tools.description: Manage extended variable collections (Enterprise): list, get, create from library, set/remove overrides

action.description: Action to perform on extended collection(s)

collectionId.description: Collection ID (required for get, set_override, remove_override)
